scripts.build: npm run build -w @radar/contracts && npm run build -w @radar/api && npm run build -w @radar/admin
scripts.check: npm run check -w @radar/contracts && npm run check -w @radar/api && npm run check -w @radar/admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,admin -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @radar/api" "npm run dev -w @radar/admin"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @radar/contracts && npm run test -w @radar/api && npm run test -w @radar/admin
